FIELDS.NAME: The Deli Delight
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At The Deli Delight, we specialize in creating fresh, gourmet sandwiches and deli items using high-quality, pre-prepared ingredients sourced from licensed and reputable vendors. Our operations are focused on assembling and serving delicious sandwiches, salads, and sides without the use of any commercial-grade cooking equipment or open flames, ensuring a safe and compliant environment. We operate with a skilled team of part-time staff who have been trained in food safety protocols, allowing us to maintain the highest standards for food safety and hygiene. To enhance customer experience, we provide a cozy setting for patrons to enjoy their meals but do not have outdoor seating or serve alcoholic beverages. Our hours of operation are convenient for local customers, positioned strategically within a busy urban area to capture regular foot traffic. We are committed to compliance with all local health department regulations and food safety standards, ensuring a reliable and delightful dining experience for all our guests.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any open flame cooking or use commercial-grade cooking equipment and confirms that food preparation is conducted exclusively with household-type appliances, such as microwave ovens and toasters. Additionally, we maintain annual gross revenue below $500,000 to uphold our preferred status, and we do not allow on-premises catering or event hosting.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses due to equipment malfunction on 07/15/2022, resulting in a small fire that caused property damage amounting to $1,500. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, UL listed, Class B, with a secure locking mechanism and fire-resistant rating of 1 hour.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and security cameras at access points.
